system.description: You have attracted the attention of another Toreador who has made it her business to see you succeed, whether due to your lineage, your artwork, or something you did or said. She will champion your work, speak up for you in the courts, and may arrange shelter or training. A two-point Patron is roughly your own station but older and wiser; a four-point Patron has real resources and enough standing to make a significant difference in your unlife. Take care not to abuse her patronage.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
